context: A field-operations company approves safety inspections at remote sites with poor connectivity. Inspectors use iPads. A single inspection has 20-80 checklist answers, 0-12 photos, GPS coordinates, inspector notes, and a final supervisor approval. Inspectors may edit an inspection offline for up to 72 hours. Supervisors may approve from the web dashboard while an inspector is still offline. The company must keep an immutable audit trail for 7 years. Some sites are under legal hold, so deletion requests must preserve audit records but hide personal data from normal product views. The first release must support 2,000 inspectors, 300 supervisors, and roughly 50,000 inspections per month. Current backend is Postgres + S3 + a queue worker. There is no CRDT infrastructure. Product wants the simplest UX: 'sync when online, never lose my work.' Security insists photos may contain faces and license plates. Finance wants the release in six weeks, not a platform rewrite.
task: Design the first production-ready version of an offline-capable approval workflow. Balance product ergonomics, data correctness, and security/compliance.
title: Offline Field Approval System Design
